description: Enhanced wildcard and catch-all edge cases: a single-label wildcard matches only one label deep so a multi-label subdomain is not matched by the wildcard alone, and when both a wildcard and a catch-all are registered the bare base domain (not a subdomain) falls through to the catch-all while a single-label subdomain still resolves to the wildcard. Each registration reports success and each probe reports the response status with the backend body.

cases.expected_output:
deploy sw ok
status=404 target=Not Found

deploy sw ok
deploy sc ok
status=200 target=catch
status=200 target=wild
